page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for boot volumes and data persistence.

The underlying CPU configuration for this instance type does not expose advanced instruction set extensions. Specifically, hardware-assisted virtualization (VMX, SVM), advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX512, AVX_VNNI), matrix multiplication extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are unavailable. Additionally, hyper-threading and bit manipulation extensions such as BMI2 and FMA are not active on this instance profile.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s2.large is structured for entry-level workloads that require predictable CPU access without the overhead of shared-core burst models. It is suitable for lightweight utility services, basic web serving, small-scale application hosting, and development environments that do not rely on specialized vector or cryptographic instruction sets.
